description: U.S. Marines with the 22nd Marine Expeditionary Unit participate in a during a non-lethal weapons course at Marine Corps Base Stone Bay, April 29th, 2025. The non-lethal weapons course teaches students about weapons that are explicitly designed and primarily employed to incapacitate personnel or materiels while minimizing fatalities, permanent injury to personnel, and undesired damage to property and the environment.
